blurb: Guests explore a new corn maze each year, enjoy a petting zoo, train rides, and seasonal attractions like sunflowers in summer and pumpkins in fall. The farm offers picnic areas with barbeques and firepits for group events and birthday parties. It is located about 20-30 minutes northwest of Lethbridge near Park Lake.
